result_text:
The stock list of a warehouse now leaves out products with no stock. The change is one filter in `StockStore.listInWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockStore.java`, around line 98): `WHERE s.warehouse_id = ?` became `WHERE s.warehouse_id = ? AND s.quantity > 0`. I also updated its Javadoc to say "with stock". This is the same `quantity > 0` filter the other stock overviews in that file already use.

`findQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still returns 0. I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest=StockTest,StockOverviewTest` and it passed with no output. I did not add a test for the bolt/nut/screw example. Nothing is committed.
